title: Sulaymaniyah Museum, Halabja & Biyara
full_text:
Visit the Sulaymaniyah Museum, a treasure trove of Kurdish history and artifacts.
Head to Halabja, and pay homage at the Halabja War Monument commemorating the chemical genocide.
Head to Biyara Village, and explore the Iran-Iraq border along a scenic stream.
Short hike in an abandoned village near hawraman.
Visit the iconic botanical farm for fruit tasting with a renowned local farmer.
Head back to Sulaymaniyah.
